Construcción de la cadena

The process of assembling a complete, ordered set of certificates from an end-entity certificate up to a trusted root, verifying each link in the trust chain.

Questions and answers

What is Construcción de la cadena?

In this glossary, Construcción de la cadena refers to: The process of assembling a complete, ordered set of certificates from an end-entity certificate up to a trusted root, verifying each link in the trust chain.

How is Construcción de la cadena used in cybersecurity?

In cybersecurity communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "La construcción de la cadena garantiza que cada certificado puede rastrearse hasta una CA raíz de confianza, permitiendo decisiones de confianza automatizadas."

Definition

The process of assembling a complete, ordered set of certificates from an end-entity certificate up to a trusted root, verifying each link in the trust chain.

Operational example

Chain building ensures every certificate in the chain can be traced to a trusted root CA, enabling automated trust decisions.
